api_docs_intro: Generate 800×480 BMP images for E-Ink displays showing F1 race schedules in 1bit, B/W/R, or Spectra 6 mode.
api_docs_eink_desc: Fetch /calendar.bmp and display directly on your E-Ink display. Recommended refresh interval: every 1-6 hours. Compatible with any 800×480 E-Ink display (e.g., Waveshare 7.5", LaskaKit).
api_docs_teams_desc: Generate a BMP image showing all F1 teams with their drivers, photos, and championship points in 1bit, B/W/R, B/W/R/Y, or Spectra 6 output modes.
api_docs_teams_json_desc: Get all teams with drivers and points for a season (JSON)
api_docs_standings_leader_desc: Get current championship leaders (driver and constructor)

privacy_intro_text: F1.InkyCloud.click is a public noncommercial service without accounts, advertising or payments.
privacy_data_text: The default configuration keeps operating totals, without individual visitor records:
privacy_data_usage: Usage: hourly request counts and response totals by public settings. No IP address, User-Agent, referrer or visitor identifier is stored. Retention: {retention} days.
privacy_data_webvitals: Performance: a random {sample}% sample of page loads sends numeric Web Vitals once. Only hourly histograms remain, rounded to 50 ms and 0.01 CLS. Retention: {perf_retention} days. These are approximate performance statistics, not unique visitor counts.
privacy_data_errors: Errors: when configured, GlitchTip receives scrubbed error types and code stack locations, without request bodies, user details, breadcrumbs, local variables, tracing or profiling. Application and access logs are disabled in the default profile.
privacy_data_local: Preferences: the language is saved in localStorage and a functional cookie for one year. The browser detects the time zone. Selected settings are sent in the URL to generate your image. Clear browser site data to remove the preference.
privacy_thirdparty_text: Hosting is with Hetzner in Germany. Optional Umami receives only hourly server summaries, never browser requests. Optional GlitchTip receives scrubbed errors. Credits show which integrations are active. Provider logs and backups require separate retention settings.
privacy_gdpr_text: Your IP address and HTTP headers are necessarily received to deliver the service, even though the application does not persist them. Reducing collection does not remove all GDPR obligations. Applicable rights include access, correction, erasure and objection; complaints may be submitted to the Czech ÚOOÚ.
privacy_opensource_text: The application code is under the MIT licence. Maps, data, fonts and logos have separate rights described in Credits.
privacy_contact_text: For application questions, use GitHub. Do not publish personal data in public issues.

credits_page.intro: Maps use the licensed outlines below. InkyCloud contributors select, rotate, recolour and decorate them. Relief and colour divisions are decorative, not elevation measurements or official sectors. The listed layout is also used for historical races.
credits_page.licences: Jules Roy (ROY Jules): CC BY 4.0. Commons authors and licences are listed per file. The artwork licence is separate from the code licence; our adaptations of CC0 outlines use CC BY 4.0.
credits_page.wikiChange: Selected table cells, normalized JSON and corrections. Original import revision was not recorded.
credits_page.ai: The maintainer identifies the car illustration as AI-generated; model, prompt and generation terms were not recorded.
credits_page.logos: Team logos identify their rights holders. They are outside the code and map licences; written redistribution permission is not recorded. Display does not indicate partnership or endorsement.
credits_page.adaptation: Selected outline, transformed, rotated, recoloured and decorated by InkyCloud. Height and colour divisions are decorative.
credits_page.apiParameters: The same track_style, track_source, track_accent parameters
